sloka: कौसल्या लोकभर्तारं सुषुवे यं मनस्विनी ।तं ममार्थे सुखं पृच्छ शिरसा चाभिवादय ।। ५.३८.५६।।।।
transliteration: kausalyā lokabhartāraṁ suṣuve yaṁ manasvinī ।taṁ mamārthe sukhaṁ pṛccha śirasā cābhivādaya ।। 5.38.56।।।।

translations.english: "Bow to Rama and offer salutations on my behalf. Inquiries concerning his welfare should be addressed to Rama, whom virtuous Kausalya bore as a son.
